Zara: Heads-up — Acuity asked for a formal 'migration bridge' pattern so they can avoid hard pins during a phased infra+model rewrite. They want clear guardrails + credits. cc @Ken @Bel
Ken: What's their current pin and the blocker? Need baseline metrics before we offer discounts.
Zara: They're on rwd-20b-v1, ~130 QPS, eu-central heavy. Canary shows ~3.9% semantic delta on their seed set and p95 +12ms. Embedding recall@10 down ~2.8pp. They said search quality drop is driving the request.
Bel: 3.9% is above our 3% threshold for enterprise. Two ideas: (A) reusable "bridge" lane (14/30/60d) with staged credits, or (B) cohort canary where we let a subset of Acuity users opt into new variant for 2 weeks and we collect live metrics. Cohort reduces customer exposure.
Ruth: Ops prefers cohort canaries — shadow-serve + opt-in cohort gives real signal, and rollback is trivial per-user. But we need a preflight checklist and a credit escrow model so finance isn't eating risk.
Ken: Draft preflight checklist:
```text
- seed-set semantic eval (pass rate + error taxonomy)
- embedding similarity: median cosine delta + recall@k
- perf smoke per-region (p50/p95)
- shadow-serve 48h telemetry OK
- cohort opt-in gating (AB percentage + rollback hook)
- structured-output field invariants
```
Bel: Add: migration must include an embeddings-schema check (dims, dtype, ordering). Also require a rerank top-k audit for their search flows.
Zara: Credit/escrow proposal: frontloaded escrow (10% for 14d, 15% for 30d, 22% for 60d) released weekly only if live-cohort improvement >= 0 or no critical regressions. Legal/Finance sign-off for >15%.
Ruth: Implementation notes: infra will provide a cohort canary template (traffic split + per-user rollback), weekly CI job to compute improvement score, and webhook to trigger rollback to pinned variant. I'll own the webhook.
Ken: Bench exit gates suggestion per lane: 14d -> semantic delta <=2% OR non-critical regressions + mitigation; 30d -> delta <=2.5% & perf within +8ms; 60d -> delta <=3% with weekly positive trend and mitigation plan.
Bel: Customer asks for guaranteed rollback window and a weekly customer-status email. We'll template that. Also capture accounting in billing exports.
Zara: Action items: (1) Ken + Ruth to prototype cohort canary + webhook, (2) Bel to draft escrow wording and SLO bands, (3) Zara to draft comms + contract snippet. Target internal draft in 4 business days — Acuity wants an answer in 8 business days. :hourglass: \nomar-bot: FYI — discounts >15% require finance approval ticket.
Ken: I'll post a minimal cohort runbook and a sample CI gating job by EOD tomorrow.
Bel: I'll include a rerank top-k audit and embedding-schema checklist in the doc.
Zara: Thanks. We'll review the draft in product sync. Keep notes concise so CS can forward to Acuity. :rocket:
